review_process: Three separately prompted read-only gpt-5.6-sol/ultra roles reviewed primary-source content, representation and adversarial claims; parent alone acquired, edited and adjudicated. Potentially correlated computational review, not independent human review or laboratory evidence.

reviews.scope: Complete main article, all six SI groups, exact caption/media binding, current deposit, quantities, source conflicts, cumulative receipts and claim propagation.
Construct, assay and endpoint joins; exact 120-residue deposited sequence, 11 numbering maps, five atom pairs, three ligands, two kinetic rows, eight arms and explicit unknowns.
Control versus structural variant, deposited versus assay identity, benzoate prose/plot conflict, qualitative knockout and pKa limits, restrained docking and unsupported design transfer.

adjudications.evidence: Main Section2.4 p9 and exact XML S4 caption/media member.
adjudications.decision: Preserve both sources and variant mismatch; only visual ordering/retained signal, no invented rates, significance, Ki, no-effect threshold, ligand independence or16.1 effect.
